item.description:
The samples in this folder are the setup for one data subscriber from US, with imsi 310150123456789 (which will also be used as account ID). Should be the same for any other subscriber, just change the IMSI, region and prices.

The account is picked by its filters, matched against the imsi the radius side sends (it maps User-Name to \~\*req.IMSI). So each account carries a rule for its own imsi. The account id is just a label, the imsi filter is what selects it.

More specifically, from the matrix xlsx file, it's the setup for the following row:

```
Data Allowance,Countries,Duration,Plan Price,Overage Price
1 GB,US-Only,1 Month,$10.00,$15.00 Per GB

 ```

request.description: The filter selects the account by `req.IMSI`.

`Targets.\\*accounts` lists the accounts that receive the bundle. When run, this profile creates the data balance with 1 GB.

\*Keep the backticks in the `Weights` and `CostIncrements` values. They keep the values from being split at the semicolons.

For this example, the monthly topup runs on the first day of each month at 00:00 in the engine’s local time zone. Each run adds 1 GB and keeps any unused data.

For more accounts, put their IDs under `Targets.\*accounts` before calling `ScheduleActions`.
`ScheduleActions` adds only accounts not already scheduled for this profile. Set `APIOpts.*overwrite` to `true` to replace its existing jobs.

item.name: Sessions - Sample Data Usage Debit
item.description:
# Sessions Sample: Data Usage Debit

This folder shows how a data session is charged against a data balance, from start to finish.

**Example:** the account starts with a balance of 1000 MiB of data. Each step in the session uses 1 MiB.

## Steps

| Step | Request | What it shows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Get Active Sessions | No session is open yet. |
| 2 | Get Account | The starting balance: 1000 MiB. |
| 3 | Start session | Opens the session and records 1 MiB of usage. Nothing is deducted yet. |
| 4 | Get Active Sessions | The session is open with 1 MiB of usage. |
| 5 | Update session | Deducts 1 MiB from the balance. |
| 6 | Get Active Sessions / Get Account | The session shows 2 MiB of usage and the balance is 1 MiB lower. |
| 7 | End session | Deducts another 1 MiB and closes the session. |
| 8 | Get Account / Get Active Sessions | The balance is 2 MiB lower than at the start and no session is open. |

Use the same session ID ```*originID``` in all requests of one session.
The balance only changes in requests that include ```*debit```.
To run the example again, make sure no old session is still open and that the balance is back to 1000 MiB
